clue.text: Supports abandoning original recipe for dessert

the start of the word

taken as written

clue.text: Briefly, where all works of Roald Dahl begin

clue.text: I can make stuff that doesn't work

clue.text: Old cleaner puts bag in back seat

clue.text: By law, flat is converted for incompetent hotelier

explanation.definitionFit: Basil Fawlty is the rude, bungling owner of a Torquay hotel, TV's best-known inept innkeeper.

clue.text: Foolishly broke plastic lid for game one plays with oneself

clue.text: Smooth on natural moisturiser — it should be dry above it
